short: An English carrack and flagship of Henry VIII, which sank during the Battle of the Solent.
full:
Launched in 1511, the Mary Rose served for over thirty years as a heavily armed warship in the English Tudor navy. She participated in multiple wars against France, Scotland, and Brittany, representing a transition toward ships built specifically to carry heavy cannons.

On 19 July 1545, she sank suddenly in the Solent while engaging a French invasion fleet. The exact cause remains debated, but sudden water ingress through open gun ports is commonly cited. Her wreck was rediscovered and famously raised in 1982, yielding an unparalleled time capsule of Tudor maritime life and early modern naval warfare.
